sample_unit: LLMs evaluated on a single hyperthyroidism Synthea model
unlisted_practices: Iterative LLM refinement using automated structural and requirements validation feedback to generate synthetic patient journey models
Use of authoritative medical sources as input for LLM-based model generation
Human expert review of LLM-generated Synthea models to catch structural deficits and medical code errors

screen.reason: The study empirically tests using LLMs within a structured 4-stage pipeline incorporating syntax/requirements validation and iterative refinement to generate agent-based synthetic patient journey models (Synthea), comparing baseline vs iteratively refined outputs and assessing the need for human oversight.

primary.practice: iterative automated feedback validation and human expert oversight
